uncovered.support.system: the support agent answers from the help corpus, which the eval harness cannot reach without the support retrieval stack; covered today by apps/web/lib/support tests, not by a graded corpus
uncovered.voice.live_instructions: spoken output over a WebRTC session; the harness grades text from a non-streaming completion and cannot hold a voice turn
uncovered.voice.live_backend_instructions: reached only from a live voice session's delegation, same limitation as voice.live_instructions
uncovered.voice.live_context_rules: applies inside a live voice session, same limitation as voice.live_instructions
uncovered.product.memory_fact_extraction: no corpus yet; extraction is gradeable with the structured-output checks and is the next prompt to cover
uncovered.agent.cloud_code_system: runs inside a sandbox with the agent's file tools; the coding corpus grades written code, not a sandboxed agent loop
uncovered.tool.places_search_description: needs live place results to grade a tool choice against; the tools corpus covers tool.url_fetch_description instead
